evidence.text: The LORD does not let the righteous go hungry, but He denies the craving of the wicked.
The blessing of the LORD enriches, and He adds no sorrow to it.
The fear of the LORD prolongs life, but the years of the wicked will be cut short.
The way of the LORD is a refuge to the upright, but destruction awaits those who do evil.

matchReviews.senseReview: Only literal uppercase LORD is admitted globally. Source Lord article explicitly covers God as Lord; lowercase human lord and sentence-title Lord are not inferred from this rule.
